title: Herbal Pork Knuckle Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew featuring tender pork knuckle in a rich herbal broth.
instructions: Season the pork knuckle with salt and pepper.
Sear the pork knuckle in a pan over medium-high heat until browned on all sides.
Transfer the pork knuckle to a Dutch oven or oven-safe pot.
Add the minced jubilant, fresh herbal sprigs, and chicken broth to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the pork is tender and falls off the bone.
Add the mushrooms to the pot and continue to braise for another 30 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional fresh herbs if desired.
